dict.A doua parte a documentului: se deruleaz: The second part of the document: it scrolls separately and shows right away what you write above; double-click = write in that place
dict.Trage ca să schimbi cât ocupă fiecare pa: Drag to change how much each part takes up; double-click = Remove Split
dict.Eliminare scindare: documentul din nou î: Remove Split: the document in a single part again (Ctrl+Alt+S)
dict.Scindare (Ctrl+Alt+S): documentul în dou: Split (Ctrl+Alt+S): the document in two parts of the window, each scrolled separately, so you can see one place while you write in another (double-click below = write there)
